title: PHP 5.0.0's Zend allocator (zend_alloc.c) with a Capstone seam: per-object bounds on the recorded request size, and the sublet/ adapter that splits each emalloc block into a header and a CDERIVE/CREVOKE payload region the app port's protected arms run on

pin_source.grep: CRASH-008 matched pair: PHP 5.0.0's Zend allocator, unpatched, in a Capstone domain.

workload: run-crash008.sh (spatial, a corpus case) and run-uaf.sh (temporal, synthetic) in a physical domain; sublet/probe-seam.c and sublet/probe-derive-split.c on the virtual profile, which qualify the seam before the app port's arms are believed
note: Not historical: sublet/ is the adapter the app port's seam arms link, and app/patches/php-5.0.0-0003-zend-alloc-sublet-hooks.patch is what its build applies to zend_alloc.c for its block, object and exact arms (PHP_CAP_MODE 4, 6 and 7); only the domain runners here are from the physical-profile phase. The block provider was moved onto CDERIVE/CREVOKE on 2026-10-26 after the nested loan ABI was removed upstream.
